name: Pallyy
description:
Pallyy is a social media scheduling and management tool that lets you plan, write, and schedule posts to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky, YouTube, and Google Business Profile directly from Claude.

Ask Claude to draft a week of posts, then schedule them in a single post set. Claude can write platform-specific captions, attach images or videos from your media library, import new media from a URL, and set the publish time for each network.

What you can do:

- List your social sets (brands or clients) and their connected accounts
- Create, view, and update post sets, including per-network captions and media
- Browse your media library and import new files from public URLs
- Add, view, and update calendar notes pinned to specific dates
- Review scheduled and draft posts for any social set

The connector uses OAuth 2.1, so Claude only accesses the social sets your Pallyy account is authorised to manage. You stay in control: Claude creates and edits posts on your behalf, and you can review everything in the Pallyy calendar before it publishes.

Ideal for content planning, batch scheduling, client reporting prep, and keeping multiple brand calendars organised from one conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pallyy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pallyy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.pallyy.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pallyy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pallyy lists 14 MCP tools, including create_media_upload, create_note, create_post_set, get_media, get_media_upload, get_note, get_post_set, get_social_set, list_media, list_notes, list_post_sets, and list_social_sets.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pallyy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Pallyy in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Pallyy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pallyy is developed by Pallyy. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
